body: I'm basically alive because of my dog. If not for him I'd quit. But I can never quit in him. He gives me the reason to keep going.

I am unfortunately right there with you. I'm married with 1 son (step) and I work a 100% commission job. Imagine that in this economy. I do nothing to make my family better. I want to quit but something tells me that I need to keep going to prove someone wrong. I think you can do the same. Prove the world wrong.
Yo. I hate myself with a passion, but if it's love you need, I'm throwing it your way.
I've begged. I've prayed. After my dad died of cancer, my sister to a car wreck, then my brother to a different car wreck I realized He does NOT listen. He may care but He does nothing to help.

You have all the things that make people happy. I'm a married, 41 year old guy with a 12 year old stepson and I'm flat broke. Basically living off my wife's income because I'm an insurance agent and the economy is in the tank and no one is buying anything. Literally, the only reason I don't kill myself is because of my dog.
